item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Reyansh holding his hand beside a lit clay lamp without touching it. His hand feels warm.

How does heat reach his hand?

options.A: Radiation — heat reaches his hand from the lamp without needing contact.
options.B: Conduction — heat passes only through contacting solid parts.
options.C: Convection — lamp particles themselves move into his hand.
options.D: Conduction — any warmth felt near a lamp is conduction.
